name: Inniku Kaizou Ranbu ~Kurutta Shinka no Michibiki~
original_name: 淫肉改造乱舞 ～狂った進化の導き～
source:
Manya is taken prisoner in King Leo's castle and used as material for an evolution experiment using the "hidden treasure" of Balzac, the avenging enemy.
Manya is subjected to obscene "body modification" and humiliation in the name of "adjustment".
And what fate awaits her...

The player manipulates Balzac to create the "mother body that produces the ultimate creature.
The game is a simple SLG in which the player modifies and adjusts the body of Manya.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ051565.html/]DLsite[/url]]

A parody of [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dragon_Quest_IV]Dragon Quest 4: Chapters of the Chosen[/url].
translation:
被囚禁在金雷欧城的玛妮娅，被仇敌巴尔扎克当作使用“秘宝”进行进化实验的素材。
她遭到淫猥的“肉体改造”，并以“调整”之名受到凌辱。
等待她的，究竟会是怎样的命运……

玩家将操纵巴尔扎克，打造“能够孕育究极生物的母体”。
这是一款简单易玩的模拟游戏，玩家需要对玛妮娅的身体进行改造与调整。

[译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ051565.html/]DLsite[/url]]

本作是[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dragon_Quest_IV]《勇者斗恶龙4：被引导的人们》[/url]的同人作品。
